a letter, just for you. tap to open

Dear you,

Happy 13th birthday! Thirteen is a big one. It's the year everything starts to feel a little more real, and I'm so glad I get to know you while you grow into who you're becoming.

I made this little corner of the internet because a normal card felt too small. The playlist is full of songs that remind me of you. The bouquet is yours to build, because you deserve flowers you picked yourself. The letters are for later, whenever you need them. There are a few little games in here too.

I hope this year is full of good music, loud laughs, and people who treat you exactly the way you deserve. I hope you stay as kind as you are.

Happy birthday. I'm really glad you exist.
